-- Phase 2: implementation. Defaults: mode=fast, level=3.
-- Output order: mode, level, then the other keys in the order given.

settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  ex settings(["x", "mode"], ["a", "b"]) == ["b", "3", "a"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    if keys[i] == "mode"
      mode = values[i]
    else if keys[i] == "level"
      level = values[i]
  var res: List[str] = []
  res.append(mode)
  res.append(level)
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    if k == "mode" or k == "level"
      continue
    var first = True
    for j in range(0, i)
      if keys[j] == k
        first = False
    if first
      var last = i
      for j in range(i + 1, keys.len())
        if keys[j] == k
          last = j
      res.append(values[last].copy())
  res
